dialogues.speaker: Gygax
dialogues.text: Hey there, fancy trying your hand at Windtrace?

response.speaker: Gygax
response.text: I'm glad you asked. Windtrace is a game that's all about Mondstadt's history!

response.speaker: Gygax
response.text: I suppose you've heard of the aristocrats who once lived in Mondstadt City?

response.speaker: Gygax
response.text: They were tyrants, and their rule was brutal. Words cannot do justice to the way that people suffered at their hands...

response.speaker: Gygax
response.text: To fight back against their oppression, a group of brave citizens came together and formed an underground resistance.

response.speaker: Gygax
response.text: These valiant rebels engaged in operations throughout the city, becoming a major thorn in the side of the aristocrats.

response.speaker: Gygax
response.text: But the aristocrats retaliated, quickly training up their own team of henchmen to suppress the rebels.

response.speaker: Gygax
response.text: And so, the rebels fought duel after duel with the aristocrats' lackeys all across Mondstadt.

response.speaker: Gygax
response.text: Windtrace takes its inspiration from this thrilling chapter of Mondstadt's history! And it used to be quite popular, too...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Used to be?

response.speaker: Gygax
response.text: Sadly, yes. Young people these days don't seem very interested in the game...

response.speaker: Gygax
response.text: But I can't let Windtrace fade into obscurity. So, I tweaked the rules a little to make it easier to get into and more fun.

response.speaker: Gygax
response.text: I also added a whole load of brand-new maps in. Hopefully, this will help to attract more people...

response.speaker: Gygax
response.text: Alright, well, if you're ever interested to try it out, you know where to find me.

dialogues.speaker: Gygax
dialogues.text: Hey there, fancy trying your hand at Windtrace?

choices.text: So, what's the situation with Windtrace?

response.speaker: Gygax
response.text: I previously got some people to do a round of play-testing for Windtrace. Some of them were extremely good. Made a real impression on me, in fact.

response.speaker: Gygax
response.text: But a lot of people said that the game was pretty tough. Either it was Rebels claiming that they had few escape options, or it was the Hunters complaining that they couldn't find anyone.

response.speaker: Gygax
response.text: Some even griped that you have to be very familiar with each map to play properly, and asked that I simplify the gameplay.

response.speaker: Gygax
response.text: *sigh* I don't know who to listen to, so I decided to invite another batch of people to play-test the game, and I'll hear what they have to say.

response.speaker: Gygax
response.text: If you're interested, please have a go at it.

dialogues.speaker: Gygax
dialogues.text: Hey there, fancy trying your hand at Windtrace?

choices.text: Still looking for people to have a go at it, huh?

response.speaker: Gygax
response.text: Oh, it's you! I was really impressed with the technique you exhibited the last time you played Windtrace.

response.speaker: Gygax
response.text: Though you seem to be adept at the game, a lot of people say that the game is pretty tough. Be it Rebels claiming that they have few escape options, or the Hunters complaining that they can't find anyone.

response.speaker: Gygax
response.text: Some people also complained to me that the Rebels caught by the Hunters have utterly nothing to do until the end of the game, and can only watch from the side, which is really boring for them...

response.speaker: Gygax
response.text: *sigh* I don't know who to listen to, so I decided to invite another batch of people to play-test the game and share their feedback.

dialogues.speaker: Gygax
dialogues.text: Hello! Are you here to try your hand at Windtrace?

response.speaker: Gygax
response.text: Sure! This way, please...

choices.text: So, I heard Windtrace has some new rules?

response.speaker: Gygax
response.text: Ah yes, let me tell you about that. I've added some cool new stuff!

response.speaker: Gygax
response.text: I've introduced something called a Signaling Device in this brand-new version of Windtrace.

response.speaker: Gygax
response.text: As long as the Rebels can activate 4 such Devices, they'll defeat the Hunter and emerge victorious!

response.speaker: Gygax
response.text: Whereas the Hunter... Well, nothing's changed there! If they manage to capture all the Rebels, they win.

response.speaker: Gygax
response.text: But in this version of Windtrace, when Rebels get caught by the Hunter, they won't be knocked out straight away. Instead, they'll be kept in what's known as the "Surveillance Zone."

response.speaker: Gygax
response.text: After waiting a bit, or with the help of other Rebels, they can escape from the Surveillance Zone and carry on playing.

response.speaker: Gygax
response.text: But if a Rebel who's previously been caught gets captured a second time... they'll be knocked out of the game completely.

response.speaker: Gygax
response.text: So you see, the rules are actually very simple. You'll get the hang of it once you've played a few times.

response.speaker: Gygax
response.text: So come try out this brand-new version of Windtrace!

response.speaker: Gygax
response.text: No worries. Come back when you're free — I'll be here for a while yet.
